verdict.rationale: Xero markets JAX as an in-product 'AI finance partner' that categorizes and matches transactions for you. The homepage promises 'instant answers about your cash flow, profit trends and financial health', which covers in-product, data-driven insights and suggestions. AI also extracts bill details into draft bills and duplicate bills are flagged automatically. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how the AI insights and answers work (scope, proactive vs on-demand), explicit confirmation that the cash-flow answers are AI-generated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
